122_HeroVoice_ST.MarvelHeroVoiceTable_40170306_Lines: Меджік покликана! Тепер ви зможете активувати командну здібність «Диск Джалії».
122_HeroVoice_ST.MarvelHeroVoiceTable_80310025_Lines: Гей, Меджік! А ці твої портали в інші реальності не телепортують?
122_HeroVoice_ST.MarvelHeroVoiceTable_40170300_Lines: Слава Чорній пантері - лютому дуелянту, готовому вийти на полювання!

601_HeroUIAsset_1030_ST.HeroUIAssetBPTable_10300010_HeroGalleryI: "Who else?» Spector asked.<lf>»I already mentioned Spider-Man. Reed and Tony survive, and a few stragglers like Cloak and Dagger, and of course Squirrel Girl. They are working on a device that might knit the timelines back together. That is their task. A few others keep small groups of survivors safe and do what they can to keep streets safe for travel. My task, and Wanda's, is to find the Darkhold and liberate it from Dracula's castle. And Blade, if we can find him…»<lf>»Who's Wanda?» <lf>»You might know her better as the Scarlet Witch.«<lf>»Right," Spector nodded. "Another crazy one like me.«<lf>Reality bent a little around Spector then, and he felt Khonshu's presence. You demean My presence when you mock your sanity, avatar. For if you are insane, what am I but a vision?<lf>You know I don't mean it.<lf>I care not what you mean. What you say, that I care about. And what you do.<lf>Well, looks like I'm going to fight Dracula and put the Moon back on its course. That's why you sent me here, isn't it?<lf>This eternal full Moon, it pleases me…but I am the god of the horned moon as well. Remember, Marc Spector, you are here to fight my battle. If I choose to keep the blood moon, that is what you will fight to do. <lf>Yeah. Got it.<lf>You will know when I have made my decision.<lf>Spector blinked and became aware of his surroundings again. Strange was watching him.<lf>»Pleasant visit?» he inquired politely.<lf>»Khonshu doesn't really do pleasant," Spector said. "What were we talking about?»<lf>Strange nodded. "If we can find Blade and the Darkhold, then we can reverse Dracula's enchantment — and," Strange added darkly, "prevent him from casting another.«<lf>»That doesn't sound good.«<lf>»It isn't. Dracula seeks the knowledge within the Darkhold of a spell that will free vampires to walk in the sun.«<lf>Spector recalled Khonshu's words. If I choose to keep the blood moon…<lf>He shook it off. "Well," Spector said after a while. "At least then he could let the Moon move again.«<lf>Strange did not smile. "Khonshu or Dracula?»<lf>Spector shrugged.<lf>»Your god has either sent you on this errand or let me find you and bring you here," Strange said. "Either way, I don't think he wanted you to sit on your hands until Dracula works his next great spell.«<lf>»Lighten up, Strange," Spector said. "A soldier needs a little black humor once in a while. And you don't need to explain Khonshu to me.«<lf>»All right, soldier," Strange said. "I hope you aren't angry that I borrowed you from your timeline. In this world, Moon Knight was a powerful figure, much looked up to. We need him.«<lf>»Angry? No, it's all good," Spector said. "In my universe, Dracula has owed me money for ages and I could never track him down.«<lf>He looked up at the blood-red moon, letting it fuel his fury. "But I got a feeling he won't be too hard to find around here.»
601_HeroUIAsset_1030_ST.HeroUIAssetBPTable_10300010_HeroGalleryl: “Come to me, my Moon Knight!” <lf>The ancient voice boomed in the back of Marc Spector’s brain, momentarily throwing him off his game. It wasn’t as if hearing someone else’s words in his head was something new. He’d been sharing the space with multiple personalities for years now. But this wasn’t Jake Locksley or Steven Grant calling for his attention. It wasn’t even the enigmatic Mr. Knight. This was the boss. <lf>“I’m a bit busy…” Spector replied out loud, as he thrust his white boot into the face of yet another garishly garbed super-villain, “…trying to keep the Zodiac from ransacking one of your temples. You sent me here, remember? So, you’ll need to call back another —”<lf>“NOW,” the voice commanded. <lf>A sudden burst of pain coursed through Spector’s skull. He closed his eyes for a moment to try to clear his head. And when he opened them again, he was no longer at the heart of an epic battle between good and evil. In fact, he was nowhere. <lf>Okay, so “nowhere” might be a bit dramatic. But it’s the best that Spector could come up with to describe the blank white space between planes of reality that he had unexpectedly been transported to. A deafening silence hung in the void. For once, even the other voices in Marc Spector’s head had nothing to say. For a moment, he felt as though he was the only being that existed. But he knew better. If he had been summoned here, he was well aware who had done the summoning. <lf>“I have chosen you for a new battle, my avatar,” the ancient voice said, finally breaking the quiet. <lf>Marc Spector turned to see an enormous figure towering over him, draped in white Egyptian robes. Where his head should have been, instead there sat the skull of a long-beaked bird. Its empty sockets peered into Marc Spector’s soul, judging him. Always judging him. <lf>“Hey, Khonshu,” Spector replied casually to his patron, the Egyptian God of the Moon. “Fancy seeing you here.” <lf>“This Divine Space is where I dwell,” Khonshu replied, not seeing any humor in Spector’s words. “It is from here that I watch the realms beyond and find those who have earned my vengeance…”<lf>“Yeah,” Spector chimed in, “and from here that you sit pretty while I do your dirty work in the real world.” <lf>“This has been our arrangement since your untimely demise years ago,” Khonshu reminded Spector, “a gruesome fate you were spared by my intervention alone. Do you wish to alter our agreement?” <lf>“No…” Spector replied. “But I would like to finish one mission before you toss me into the next one. Maybe that’s just the mercenary in me…”<lf>“I have always appreciated your dedication to a task,” Khonshu said, “but more pressing matters have arisen that require your special attention.” <lf>Something about Khonshu seemed different. He was more confident. More powerful. Less scattered than usual. It was almost like all of the fragmented personas that the Moon God had presented over the years were suddenly fused into one. Spector didn’t know what had caused the change… but he thought it must be nice… <lf>“Fine,” Spector replied, beginning to grow impatient. “Just tell me whose head I need to bust open already.” <lf>Spector’s unfinished encounter with the Zodiac had pushed his level of aggression to the boiling point. He didn’t want to just stand there and talk anymore. He wanted to get back into the fight. Any fight.<lf>“What do you know of vampires?” Konshu asked curiously.<lf>“That they suck,” Spector responded with a chuckle. “And that Dracula owes me money.”<lf>“As you know,” Khonshu said, once again ignoring Spector’s attempt to infuse some levity into the situation, “I have long served as a protector for travelers in the night.”<lf>“Vicariously, through me and the other Fists of Khonshu before me,” Spector mumbled under his breath, “but sure… go on…” <lf>“Ever since they first crawled from the darkness ages ago, vampires have imperiled my people and my purpose,” Khonshu continued. “And now, I have had a vision that warns of their threat becoming far more permanent.” <lf>“I though vampires were immortal,” Spector said quizzically. “Not many threats more permanent than that.” <lf>“Immortal, yes,” Khonshu said, “but bound by their curse to the cycle of day and night. They cannot walk in the sun, so their atrocities are limited to the hours under my watch, when the moon hangs high in the sky.” <lf>“So, what’s the problem?” Spector asked. “Is Daylight Savings Time about to end or something?”<lf>“No,” another voice answered. “Daylight itself is about to end.”<lf>Spector turned to see that someone else had unexpectedly entered the Divine Space — an imposing figure in iron armor, wrapped by a dark green cloak. Spector instantly recognized the king of Latveria, Victor von Doom. <lf>“This is sacred territory!” Khonshu yelled. “You shall not foul it with your presence! Banish him, my Moon Knight!”<lf>“Yeah, yeah…” Spector said, reluctantly rushing towards Doctor Doom, “…I’m on it.”<lf>As he ran in his enemy’s direction, Spector reached into a pouch on his belt and grabbed a hand full of crescent-shaped darts. He hurled them in Doom’s direction, but the metal-clad monarch raised his gauntlet and deflected the projectiles as if they were no more than cheap toys. <lf>“I did not come here for a battle, Khonshu,” Doom said, beginning to move his hands in a strange series of gestures. “But if you must turn your champion against me as a matter of honor, so be it.”<lf>As Doom finished his series of hand motions, his armored fists began to glow with mystical flames. Soon, two curved, burning blades materialized in his grip. <lf>“The Daggers of Dormammu should end this Knight before he even begins…” Doom said, with a smirk that you could almost feel behind his faceplate. <lf>“Good luck with that,” Spector said, taking advantage of Doom’s moment of bravado to land a solid fist right to the side of his opponent’s masked face. <lf>Furious, Doom lunged at Spector, swinging his flaming daggers at the white-clad warrior. Spector dodged the thrusts easily at first, but it wasn’t long before his reactions started to slow. He’d barely had time to recover from his battle against the Zodiac, and a twelve-on-one battle tends to take a toll on even the mightiest of heroes. <lf>Doom could see his opponent beginning to falter. He started to attack even more relentlessly, eventually gaining the upper hand. A kick to the chest sent Moon Knight stumbling back. Raising the enchanted blades above his head, Doom thrust them down at Spector, narrowly missing his target’s body. Instead, the blades pierced through Moon Knight’s cape, pinning him to the floor — one Spector didn’t even realize existed in the emptiness of the Divine Space. <lf>“Enough,” Khonshu said. “You have won the right to speak.” <lf>“And when Doom speaks,” the victorious villain responded, casually gesturing for the mystical daggers to vanish, “all had best listen. For he only speaks once.” <lf>Moon Knight pulled himself back to his feet, standing between Doom and Khonshu, just in case Doom had any other tricks up his iron sleeve. <lf>“Few recall the real origin of vampires,” Doom said, “but you and I know the truth, Khonshu. Their race was born from an ancient curse inscribed in the pages of Darkhold, written in the blood of Varnae, the first of their kind. It was these Vampiric Verses that granted them immortal life, and, if my calculations are correct — which they always are — that same spell may hold the key to unlocking the very nature of time itself. I wish to study it further…” <lf>“You know not what you tamper with, foolish mortal,” Khonshu warned. <lf>“I would know full well,” Doom said, “had the Sorcerer Supreme not denied me access to the Darkhold. I have good reason to believe he has stashed it away on another plane of reality for safekeeping.” <lf>“Sounds like Strange made the right choice…” Spector said. “The last thing we need is you to accidentally unleash more vamps on the world!” <lf>“Not the world…” Doom said. “All I want is a small portion of it. And that’s where you come in. If Khonshu were simply to hold his beloved moon in the sky and shroud a single city in eternal night, it would allow me all the time I need to unlock the secrets of the vampires, even without access to the Vampiric Verses themselves.” <lf>“You’re crazy!” Spector said. “That city would instantly become a nesting ground for the creatures of the night!” <lf>“Such an act would endanger countless innocents,” Khonshu added. <lf>“Please,” Doom laughed. “Since when have the gods cared about the lives of a few million measly mortals? Together, we could use the vampires however we wish, then dispose of them completely when we —” <lf>“I will not allow this discussion to continue any further,” Khonshu said sternly, raising a bony hand to silence Doom. “There is far more at stake here than you could ever hope to know. A coming darkness lurking among the gods… a shadow even I may not be able to defeat…”<lf>“And by I, he means me,” Spector mumbled. <lf>“My avatar may have lacked the skill required to remove you from this plane,” Khonshu said, “but I have no such limits…” <lf>“You fool!” Doom cried out as he began to fade from the Divine Space. “You’re making a terrible mistake! Doom will have what he wishes, one way or another!” <lf>As Doom’s voice disappeared, a haunting silence returned to the empty whiteness surrounding Marc Spector. Khonshu was still there, but for once, it seemed the God of the Moon had nothing to say. <lf>“So what now?” Spector finally asked. <lf>“I must locate the Darkhold at once,” Khonshu replied. <lf>“The book with the spell that makes vampires?” Spector asked, confused. “Isn’t it better off stowed away wherever Strange hid it?” <lf>“Just as the Vampiric Verses created our true enemies,” Khonshu said, “There is another spell within the Book of Sins — the Montesi Formula — that could take their gift away. Permanently.”<lf>“So while you’re cruising the Astral Plane looking for a lost library book,” Spector pondered, “what on Earth am I gonna be doing?” <lf>“Protecting the night and delivering my vengeance,” Khonshu replied, “as you always have.”<lf>“And when Doom lives up to his promise and finds a way to unleash the bloodsucking hordes?” Spector asked. <lf>“Then you must be ready,” Khonshu said. “And so must I.” <lf>“I’m no vampire slayer,” Spector responded. “Isn’t that Blade’s gig? Why not call him?” <lf>“Because the Daywalker is not my Fist of Vengeance!” Khonshu replied defiantly, clearly angered that his own servant would dare question him. <lf>“Also, he is currently unavailable…” Khonshu added quietly.  <lf>“All right then,” Spector said, grinning behind his featureless mask. “But those fangers are about to find out that they aren’t the only ones who want blood.” <lf>“I expected no less. Now, go, my Moon Knight…” Khonshu said, his voice once again booming in Marc Spector’s head. “…and serve me.” <lf>Spector blinked for a split second, opening eyes to discover that he was no longer in the Divine Space. Now, he was standing on a New York City rooftop. The silence was replaced by a symphony of sounds, including a scream emanating from a nearby alleyway. He was glad to be home.<lf>As Moon Knight leapt off the edge of the building and swung across the night sky on a grappling cable, his bright white cape billowed out behind him, luminous in the light of the full moon. <lf>It must’ve been a glorious sight to behold, he thought… but if Khonshu and Doom were right about what was to come, Marc Spector knew his costume wouldn’t stay white much longer…
601_HeroUIAsset_1030_ST.HeroUIAssetBPTable_10300010_HeroGalleryI: Again, Khonshu's words rang in Marc's head. You will voyage soon… And Khonshu had permitted Strange to take him, Spector thought. That must mean Khonshu wanted Moon Knight here. Part of him rebelled against this idea. The fight against the Four Horseman needed to continue, whether it was in Thebes or anywhere else. That had been his fight for as long as he could remember. He had a hard time caring about vampires in a New York that wasn't even his.<lf>Still… "When did this happen?» <lf>»It didn't, in your timeline.» Strange gave Marc a moment to absorb this before going on. "I had quite a time finding you. There are quite a few timelines where you are…let us say unavailable.«<lf>»What about this one?» Spector asked. "This world didn't have a version of me?»<lf>»It did," Strange said. "I don't know what happened. When the Entanglement swept over all our timelines, a great many people were catapulted into different universes. A great many more died.«<lf>»It would be interesting to know what happened to me," Spector said. "This version of me.«<lf>»Feel free to ask around. Spider-Man might now. He's more in touch with what happens on the street level.«<lf>»You couldn't do some kind of magic trick and find out?»<lf>»I don't do magic tricks," Strange said, as if the words tasted bad in his mouth. "And yes, I could find out, but no, I will not, because I must reserve my powers for more urgent needs.«<lf>»Fair enough.» Spector looked out over the shadowed streets. Seeing the streets so quiet and empty gave him a chill. <lf>New York should never be like this, he thought. He looked up at the Moon again and felt a building rage. Who dared stop the Traveler? <lf>Dracula, Strange had said. <lf>Guess Moon Knight was going to be fighting Khonshu's enemies here, too. <lf>»The streets of this city are under constant siege by vampires and other terrors of the night,' Strange explained. "Surviving citizens spend most of their time hiding and trying to find a way out.«<lf>»Out like across the river?» Strange nodded confirmation to Marc's ask. "What's it like out there? How far do you have to go before there's a normal sky?»<lf>»For a normal person, it's impossible," Strange said. "But, Dracula's minions patrol the bridges and the rivers. Dire creatures lurk in the subway tunnels. After all, Dracula requires a supply of blood. So. We cannot evacuate the city; therefore we fight back as we are able.»

601_HeroUIAsset_1030_ST.HeroUIAssetBPTable_10300000_HeroGalleryI: Найманець Марк Спектор зумів уникнути смерті, коли став втіленням єгипетського бога місяця Хонсу. 601_HeroUIAsset_1041_ST.UIHeroStoryTable_10410_Story_#0_Content: The news streamed in from all over the world. The people in charge were calling it the Timestream Entanglement — a sudden disruption in the fabric of space and time that had sent chaos rippling across countless realities. The heroes of Earth had assembled to face the crisis head on. Not all of them had survived.   <lf><lf>“...entire world is in a state of mourning for Steve Rogers, the beloved hero known as Captain America, who was struck down earlier this week when...”<lf><lf>“About damn time,” a security officer in a Hydra uniform grunted, cracking a smile as he watched the satellite feed in the monitor station of the hidden Arctic base where he was stationed. <lf><lf>The officer switched the channel to see another news report discussing the theory that Victor von Doom, the ruler of the European nation of Latveria, was behind the Timestream Entanglement.  <lf><lf>“Should’ve been us…” the security officer muttered, looking up at the large, red Hydra logo hanging proudly on the wall. He shook his head in disappointment. He had devoted his life to helping Hydra destabilize the world. And now, some Super Villain in a metal suit had beaten them to the punch. Still, he thought, there would surely be plenty of opportunities for Hydra to benefit from the world’s new status quo. And the top-secret experiments being performed on the lower levels of this base were merely the beginning of what was to come… <lf><lf>The officer stood and began his patrol, exiting the monitor station and walking across the hangar to an open bay door. He gazed wistfully out at the snow-swept landing apron beyond. <lf><lf>“Another peaceful night on the edge of nowhere,” he said to himself. But he had no idea how soon his words would be proven wrong. <lf><lf>Without warning, a squad of soldiers clad in white Arctic combat gear emblazoned with Hydra’s red and black logo, came running toward the door. Before they could reach the safety of the hangar, they began to drop to the ground, one after another, each one with an arrow in their back.<lf><lf>The remaining soldiers turned, their weapons raised, as a hooded figure leapt through the snowy night sky toward them. The twin katanas in his hands flashed in the moonlight, shining brighter than the frost-covered landscape. <lf><lf>In a ballet of flashing steel, the mysterious assailant managed to wipe out the entire Hydra detachment, including the security officer. The first stage of his mission complete, the invader pulled down his hood to reveal the face beneath. It belonged to Clint Barton, the Avenger known as Hawkeye. <lf><lf>As he entered the Hydra base, stepping over the unconscious Hydra soldiers, he tried to get a sense of his surroundings as quickly as possible. There was no time to waste. Someone was waiting for him. <lf><lf>“Hang in there, Bucky,” Hawkeye said. “The cavalry’s here.”<lf><lf>Soon…<lf><lf>After navigating his way into the depths of Mount Erebus, Hawkeye entered Hydra’s Super-Soldier Lab. Nine cylindrical glass tanks filled with fluid, each connected to a computer terminal via huge conduits, bubbled and glowed ominously. On the wall, screens cycled through human anatomical diagrams, energy equations, and images of decaying, mutated cells. <lf><lf>Hawkeye stepped closer to the glass tanks, his dual blades in hand, ready for anything. He surveyed the tubes one-by-one, finally stopping at the final tank, which had a label that read “CANARY”.<lf><lf>“Jackpot,” he said with a grin. <lf><lf>Inside, partially concealed by the thick, glowing fluid, was the man that Hawkeye had been sent to retrieve. James “Bucky” Buchanan Barnes. The assassin known as the Winter Soldier. Before he could begin to set his friend free, though, a shadow unexpectedly passed behind one of the other tanks. Hawkeye looked in that direction, sword at the ready... He paused... <lf><lf>…but nothing… <lf><lf>“Hmm.” he muttered. “Nobody home.”<lf><lf>He began to sheathe the swords, returning his attention to the Winter Soldier’s tank... but instead he pivoted at the last second, parrying as an unseen figure nearly took his head off with a steel-gauntleted fist.<lf><lf>A Hydra Super-Soldier emerged from the shadows. Seven-feet-tall, teeth bared, flesh twisted, madness in his eyes. He bellowed as he charged toward Hawkeye. <lf><lf>Hawkeye dodged and counterattacked, jamming one of his katana into a joint of the Super-Soldier’s mutated arm. Quickly realizing that his swords couldn’t penetrate the Super-Soldier’s dense flesh, Hawkeye changed tactics, trying to stay out of the Super-Soldier's reach and get enough space to use his weapon of choice: his bow and arrows. <lf><lf>As Hawkeye acrobatically bounded towards the other side of the lab, the Super-Soldier dislodged the katana jammed in his arm and threw it aside with tremendous force. The spinning blade shattered the glass of one of the holding tanks, sending glowing fluid splashing everywhere. The attached computer terminal began to short out in a shower of sparks.<lf><lf>Hawkeye was too busy surviving to notice that something in the shattered tank had begun to move. He finally got enough space to raise his bow and notch an arrow, but the Super-Soldier was already on top of him. Hawkeye had nowhere left to go...<lf><lf>As the Super-Soldier swung his enormous fist down toward the archer, a mass of tentacles entangled the brute’s arm. The startled Super-Soldier tried to struggle free, but the tentacles were too strong. With a sudden pull, the Super-Soldier was sent sailing through the air, smashing against the wall. Eldritch energy surged through his massive frame, and he slumped to the floor, a lifeless husk.<lf><lf>Hawkeye scanned the room for the source of the tentacles. He was thankful for the save, but not entirely sure that he was ready to discover what new horrors had been unleashed. <lf><lf>There, standing in the shattered tank, dripping with glowing fluid, stood the Winter Soldier. But something had changed about him. Where his cybernetic arm should have been was the same writhing mass of squid-like appendages that had just made quick work of Hydra’s experimental enforcer. <lf><lf>Hawkeye stared in astonishment, for once speechless. <lf><lf>“You sure make a lot of noise,” the Winter Soldier said as he stepped out of the tank.<lf><lf>“Didn’t mean to interrupt your nap,” Hawkeye retorted, doing his best to mask his shock and concern with humor. Lowering his bow, Hawkeye retrieved his katana from next to the shattered tank and sheathed it. <lf><lf>“Come on,” he said, clearly uncomfortable as he put a hand on his old friend’s shoulder — the one without the mass of squirming limbs extending from it. “We’ll find a way to fix this. You’ll be okay. We just need to get you out of here.”<lf><lf>“Not yet,” the Winter Soldier replied. “There’s something I have to do first.”<lf><lf>“What we have to do is go back up to the landing platform,” Hawkeye said. <lf><lf>“Gotta go down before we go up, Clint,” the Winter Soldier responded. “And I’m gonna need your help. Please.”<lf><lf>Hawkeye was taken aback. The Winter Soldier wasn’t one to say “please.” He could tell that this — whatever it was — was important to Bucky. It was enough to make Hawkeye push down his instinct to get the hell out of Hydra Town. <lf><lf>“Well…” Hawkeye said with a sigh, “I guess if it was easy, anybody could do it…”<lf><lf>Hawkeye followed the Winter Soldier into a vast space, with lines of giant robot-like vehicles in various stages of construction. As they crossed an elevated catwalk that traversed the room, they heard shouting and the thudding of boot heels rapidly approaching. Hydra was on their trail. Wherever they were going, they would have to move fast. <lf><lf>Reaching a heavy door, they entered a chamber with a vaulted ceiling supported by pillars at least a hundred feet tall, each carved to look like a horrific monster. A portal yawned on one wall, with ancient energy radiating from it. Something was trying to come through from the other side… and even though Hawkeye could see it, his brain couldn’t process what the hell it was.  <lf><lf>The Winter Soldier approached an altar near the portal and climbed on top of it. Hawkeye followed reluctantly. The Winter Soldier extended his tentacles into the carvings on the altar, each one naturally sliding into the ancient stone grooves, as if they had been carved ages ago for this very moment. <lf> <lf>Fragmented memories flooded the Winter Soldier’s already fractured mind. He relived the day he first infiltrated Hydra’s secret base, getting as far as the Hive chamber. He had tried to destroy it then, but failed. Hydra soldiers overwhelmed him and tore off his cybernetic arm. Before he knew what was happening, he was sealed inside a glass tank, tiny nubs of tentacles growing from his shoulder socket, his teeth bared in a permanent scream.<lf><lf>Snapping back to reality, the Winter Soldier steeled himself, realizing what he had to do. Hawkeye glanced nervously from Bucky to the mass of Hydra soldiers that had just forced their way into the chamber.  <lf><lf>“You’d better make this quick, Buck,” Hawkeye said.<lf><lf>“Clint…” the Winter Soldier responded, gazing back at the portal behind him. Tentacles strangely similar to his own had begun to break through the membrane between realities. “How sharp are those swords of yours?”<lf><lf>“Sharp enough to cut down an entire Hydra army,” Hawkeye said proudly. But his face dropped as he realized he had no idea what his friend was about to ask him to do. “Why?”<lf><lf>“We have to close that portal,” the Winter Soldier said. “And let’s face it… I can’t exactly wear this thing to the next Avengers cookout anyway…”<lf><lf>Hawkeye glanced at the Winter Soldier’s bizarre new arm and took a deep breath. He had come here to save his friend, not to cause him more pain. But this was Bucky’s call… and it wasn’t like the guy hadn’t lost an arm before… <lf><lf>“Fine,” Hawkeye said after a long pause. “Say when.”<lf><lf>As the creature emerging from the portal wrapped its tentacle around the Winter Soldier’s waist, the altar began to glow. It was almost as if a circuit had been completed, and the Winter Soldier was the conduit. Mystical power coursed between the altar and the portal, overloading Bucky’s body with energy and agony.<lf><lf>“When!” the Winter Soldier screamed. <lf><lf>With a single clean slice, Hawkeye’s blade severed the entire bunch of tentacles just below Bucky’s shoulder, releasing a huge shockwave of energy, knocking both heroes and their Hydra pursuers to the ground.<lf><lf>A rumble echoed through the chamber, deep cracks forming in the surrounding walls, pillars beginning to topple. Then, for a moment everything fell silent… until the portal surged with energy and the monster coming through it howled in pain, retreating back to the other side. <lf><lf>When the dust cleared, Hawkeye and the Winter Soldier pulled themselves to their feet. With a quick survey of the room, reality set in. They had succeeded in stopping whatever was happening down here, but they had also cut off any escape routes in the process. <lf><lf>“Guess you shouldn’t have come after me…” the Winter Soldier said. <lf><lf>“Don’t say that,” Hawkeye replied. “I was just doing my job.”<lf><lf>“You were a hell of a soldier, Clint…” Bucky said, ready to accept the inevitable as the pillars shifted and rubble began to rain down towards them. The chamber was about to collapse and Hawkeye and the Winter Soldier knew full well that this mission would be their last. <lf><lf>Suddenly, the ancient portal began to glow again. Bucky and Clint braced for the worst, not knowing what horrors might come through it this time. But neither of them could have possibly prepared for what they saw next. <lf><lf>A round, metallic object launched through the portal at tremendous speed, ricocheting through the chamber. Chunks of falling debris shattered into tiny pebbles that sprinkled down upon the heroes harmlessly.<lf><lf>“What the —?!” the Winter Soldier gasped. He was completely shocked, but also moderately annoyed by the fact that, once again, this world wasn’t done with him quite yet. <lf><lf>A figure burst forth from the mystical gateway, lunging forward and catching the metal disc in midair. He used it to effortlessly deflect a huge stone a split second before it could crush the bewildered heroes below. The stone didn’t even make a dent in his brightly polished red, white, and blue shield.<lf><lf>“Bucky,” Captain America said, landing on the chamber floor and extending his hand to his former partner. “It’s been too long.” <lf><lf>Both Hawkeye and the Winter Soldier stared in awe, fighting through the pain and exhaustion to try and process what they were seeing. Wasn’t Cap supposed to be… dead…? <lf><lf>“Sorry I missed your funeral, old timer…” the Winter Solider said.<lf><lf>“Sorry I went to your funeral,” Hawkeye chimed in. “Clearly, you didn’t need one.”<lf><lf>“I’m… not the Steve Rogers you knew…” Cap said, trying to find the words to explain. “It’s a long story. One even I don’t fully understand yet. And one that we unfortunately don’t have the time for at the moment. My friends in Wakanda were able to hijack and redirect this portal’s energy signature to open a gateway of their own, but there’s no guarantee how long they’ll be able to keep it open…” <lf><lf>Hawkeye and the Winter Soldier looked at each other and shrugged. This was far from the weirdest thing that had happened to them today. And they were willing to wait for the full story if it meant they could get out of Hydra’s house right now. <lf><lf>“I was pretty sure we were gonna die down here,” Hawkeye said. <lf><lf>“Wasn’t about to let that happen,” Cap said confidently. “Nobody gets left behind.”<lf><lf>“Glad you’re not dead, Steve,” Bucky said, collapsing into Cap’s arms. “Umm… I think I’m gonna need a hand…”<lf><lf>“Looks like you need more than that, Buck…” Cap said, looking at the oozing stumps on the Winter Soldier’s shoulder. <lf><lf>“You know arms,” the Winter Soldier said, forcing a grin. “Easy come, easy go.”<lf><lf>“Can’t say the same about partners,” Cap said back. <lf><lf>The Winter Soldier looked over at Hawkeye, nodding at the man who had rescued him. Hawkeye nodded back knowingly. <lf><lf>“Couldn’t agree more…” the Winter Soldier said. <lf><lf>Moments later, in a crackle of energy, the heroes stepped out of the portal. They weren’t anywhere near Hydra’s frozen base. That was instantly clear. In fact, it didn’t even look like they were on Earth anymore. The strange chronal energies of the Timestream Entanglement rippled across a star-filled sky as they gazed in disbelief at the spaceport of a futuristic city. If this was Wakanda, it certainly wasn’t the one that Bucky and Clint knew.<lf> <lf>As the portal closed behind them, the heroes were greeted with a Wakandan salute from the Black Panther himself. Cap raised his hand to his forehead, offering a salute of his own. Hawkeye and the Winter Soldier remained silent and still, trying to assess their new situation.  <lf><lf>Shuri, the sister of the Black Panther and the brilliant mind behind some of Wakanda’s most impressive inventions, stepped forward and offered a box to the newly-arrived heroes. Clint took the container and held it with both hands as Bucky flipped open the lid with the one he had left. Inside was a cutting-edge cybernetic arm. <lf><lf>“I was told you might need this,” Cap said, “so I called in a favor.” <lf><lf>Bucky picked up the arm with his good hand and snapped it into place. It was a perfect fit. <lf><lf>“And now, I’m going to need a favor from you…” Cap said. <lf><lf>The Winter Soldier didn’t know what Captain America was about to ask him, but he wasn’t about to say no. Whatever came next, he would be there ‘til the end of the line.

133_MatchActivity_20001_ST.TXT_Esports_Team_LeagueInfo_Describe: Серія «Ignite» 2026 року об’єднує найкращих гравців світу з усіх чотирьох основних регіонів. Досвідчені команди повертаються, ще більш згуртовані та спраглі перемоги, а нові претенденти заявляють про себе з нестримним розмахом. Офіційні партнерські команди, гостьові команди та зірки, що проявили себе на чемпіонаті Marvel Rivals, зійдуться на одній арені в гонитві за славою. Наша мета — створити відкриту, динамічну екосистему кіберспорту, де пристрасть кожного вболівальника підживлює боротьбу. По всьому світу команди демонструватимуть приголомшливі ігрові моменти та тактичні дуелі, борючись за регіональну гордість, бажані міжнародні квоти та найвищу нагороду — титул чемпіона світу. Готуйтеся стати свідками нової ери кіберспорту Marvel Rivals, яку створює кожен гравець для кожного гравця.

133_MatchActivity_20001_ST.EsportsEventDescription_2026MSF: Фінал середини сезону IGNITE 2026 стане найяскравішою подією у світовому турнірному ландшафті Marvel Rivals. Після місяців запеклих поєдинків у передсезонному етапі та на 1-му етапі найкращі команди з наших чотирьох основних регіонів (Америка, EMEA, Китай та Тихоокеанська серія) зберуться в Лос-Анджелесі, США, щоб зійтися в очному протистоянні на світовій арені. З 29 липня по 1 серпня 10 елітних команд із 4 основних регіонів боротимуться за призовий фонд у розмірі 500 000 доларів США та найпрестижніший міжнародний трофей. Кожна з цих кіберспортивних потуг має єдину мету: довести, що вона є беззаперечним королем світу, та здобути найвищу славу чемпіона фіналу середини сезону. Хто зможе прорвати ворожі лінії на цьому полі бою героїв і вписати своє ім’я в історію Marvel Rivals? Відповідь чекає на вас у Лос-Анджелесі!
133_MatchActivity_20001_ST.EsportsEventDescription_2026STAGE1_CN: Як самостійний ключовий регіон у рамках глобальної екосистеми Marvel Rivals, серія «China Series» уособлює надії, пристрасть і любов незліченної кількості китайських гравців. Спільний дебют під час передсезонного етапу вже продемонстрував світові абсолютно нове обличчя цих команд, але саме 1-й етап стане справжнім випробуванням на міцність. На 1-му етапі серії IGNITE очки та рейтинги офіційно враховуватимуться у глобальному турнірі; кожна перемога чи поразка безпосередньо впливатиме на розподіл квот для регіону на участь у міжнародних змаганнях. 8 команд дадуть з себе все, борючись із більш досконалими тактичними системами та непохитною рішучістю, щоб здобути найвищу славу та представити міць Китаю на світовій арені.
133_MatchActivity_20001_ST.EsportsEventDescription_2026Preseason_CN: Як самостійна потужна складова глобальної екосистеми Marvel Rivals, серія «China Series» втілює надії та пристрасть незліченної кількості гравців. Цей регіон об’єднує найсильніші професійні команди Китаю, відомі своєю технічною майстерністю, бездоганною командною грою та неповторним місцевим колоритом. Передсезонна серія «Ignite Series» знаменує грандіозний дебют китайських складів 2026 року: вісім команд виходять на арену з новими амбіціями. Тут вони боротимуться за славу та напишуть наступну епічну главу в історії китайського кіберспорту Marvel Rivals.
133_MatchActivity_20001_ST.MarvelEsportsEventDescription_1003: Як самостійна потужна складова глобальної екосистеми Marvel Rivals, Китайська ліга втілює надії та пристрасть незліченної кількості гравців. У лізі зібрані найсильніші професійні команди Китаю, відомі своєю майстерністю у грі, бездоганною командною роботою та неповторним місцевим колоритом. Передсезонна серія Ignite Series знаменує грандіозний дебют китайських складів 2026 року: вісім команд виходять на арену з новими амбіціями. Тут вони боротимуться за славу та напишуть наступну епічну главу в історії китайського кіберспорту Marvel Rivals.
133_MatchActivity_20001_ST.MarvelEsportsEventPhaseRule_2026PRE_PAC_:
Азія та Океанія проведуть власні турніри, де команди пройдуть повний шлях від групового етапу до плей-оф у своїх регіонах.
Азіатська серія: 8 команд змагаються в одній групі, граючи між собою за круговою системою. Усі матчі проводяться за форматом «до трьох перемог» (BO3). Після завершення всіх матчів 6 найкращих команд за кількістю очок виходять до плей-оф Азії.
Серія Океанії: 8 команд розподіляються на 2 групи для проведення турніру за круговою системою, причому кожен матч проводиться за форматом BO3. Після групового етапу 2 найкращі команди з кожної групи виходять до плей-оф Океанії.
133_MatchActivity_20001_ST.MarvelEsportsEventPhaseRule_2026STAGE1_P: Регіони Азії та Океанії спочатку проведуть свої регіональні групові етапи. Команди, що пройдуть обидва регіональні групові етапи, спільно візьмуть участь у плей-офф «Pacific Series». Під час групового етапу: у регіоні Азії загалом візьмуть участь 8 команд. Усі команди будуть розподілені в одну групу, де зіграють за круговою системою, а кожен матч проводитиметься у форматі «до двох перемог» (BO3). Після завершення групового етапу 6 найкращих команд за набраними очками вийдуть до плей-офф «Pacific Series». У регіоні Океанії також візьмуть участь 8 команд, які змагатимуться у стадії з подвійним вибуванням, щоб визначити своє остаточне місце в турнірній таблиці. Перші два раунди верхньої сітки відбуватимуться за форматом BO3. Матчі нижньої сітки та фінали верхньої сітки проводитимуться за форматом BO5, а фінальний матч групового етапу — за форматом «до трьох перемог» (BO7). Після завершення групового етапу дві найкращі команди вийдуть до плей-офф Pacific Series.
133_MatchActivity_20001_ST.MarvelEsportsEventPhaseRule_2026PRE_PAC_:
У плей-офф «Asia Series» 6 найкращих команд, що вийшли з групового етапу, змагатимуться за системою подвійного вибування. Усі матчі, що передують Гранд-фіналу, відбуватимуться у форматі «до трьох перемог» (BO5). Гранд-фінал стане епічною битвою у форматі «до чотирьох перемог» (BO7), де лише одна команда здобуде титул чемпіона передсезонного турніру «Азіатської серії» 2026 року!
У серії «Океанія» 4 найкращі команди зійдуться у турнірі за системою подвійного вибування. Усі матчі до Великого фіналу відбуватимуться у форматі BO5, а сам Великий фінал — у форматі BO7, за результатами якого буде визначено абсолютного чемпіона передсезонної серії «Океанія» 2026 року!

133_MatchActivity_20001_ST.MarvelEsportsEventPhaseRule_2026PRE_EMEA: 8 команд, які пройдуть груповий етап, змагатимуться у турнірній сітці з подвійним вибуванням, де на кону стоїть дуже багато. 133_MatchActivity_20001_ST.EsportsEventDescription_2026STAGE1_PAC: Серія «Pacific» об’єднує численні потужні кіберспортивні команди та регіони Азії й Океанії, що робить її динамічним регіоном, де зосереджено найбільшу кількість перспективних талантів світового рівня та представлено найрізноманітніші стилі гри. Під час передсезонного етапу регіони Азії та Океанії визначили свої окремі рейтинги. Тепер на 1-му етапі ми станемо свідками офіційного злиття та зіткнення цих двох сил. На 1-му етапі серії IGNITE рівень конкуренції в Тихоокеанському регіоні значно підвищиться; офіційно розпочнуться міжрегіональні протистояння, а боротьба за очки досягне найвищої напруги. У час, коли різноманітні тактичні стилі гри запекло зіштовхуються, ми з затамованим подихом чекаємо, хто ж підніметься над цим полем бою, насиченим героями, щоб представити Азіатсько-Тихоокеанський регіон на світовій арені.
133_MatchActivity_20001_ST.EsportsEventDescription_2026Preseason_PA: Серія «Pacific Series» об’єднує гігантів кіберспорту та регіони, що активно розвиваються, з усієї Азії та Океанії, що робить її глобальним епіцентром нових талантів та найрізноманітніших стратегій. Тут досвідчені ветерани зустрічаються з безстрашними новачками, створюючи яскраве зіткнення стилів та напруги. Вісім команд з Азії та вісім з Океанії змагатимуться у передсезонному етапі, щоб визначити свої регіональні рейтинги, а найкращі з кожної сторони зійдуться у першому етапі плей-оф. Це знаменує початок нового розділу в історії Pacific Marvel Rivals Esports, запалюючи іскру для героїчного протистояння в Азіатсько-Тихоокеанському регіоні.
133_MatchActivity_20001_ST.MarvelEsportsEventDescription_1004: Тихоокеанська ліга об’єднує гігантів кіберспорту та регіони, що активно розвиваються, з усієї Азії та Океанії, що робить її глобальним епіцентром нових талантів та найрізноманітніших стратегій. Тут досвідчені ветерани зустрічаються з безстрашними новачками, створюючи яскраве зіткнення стилів та інтенсивності. Вісім команд з Азії та вісім з Океанії змагатимуться у передсезонному турнірі, щоб визначити свої регіональні рейтинги, а найкращі з кожної сторони зійдуться у першому етапі плей-оф. Це знаменує початок нової глави для Pacific Marvel Rivals Esports, запалюючи іскру для героїчного протистояння в Азіатсько-Тихоокеанському регіоні.
133_MatchActivity_20001_ST.MarvelEsportsEventPhaseRule_2026STAGE1_P: На етапі плей-офф змагатимуться 6 команд, що пройшли відбір з Азіатського регіону, та 2 команди з Океанійського регіону. Усі матчі аж до Великого фіналу відбуватимуться у форматі «до трьох перемог» (BO5), а Великий фінал — у форматі «до чотирьох перемог» (BO7). 133_MatchActivity_20001_ST.EsportsEventDescription_2026Preseason_EM: Серія EMEA об’єднує легендарні гранди та перспективних претендентів з Європи, Близького Сходу та Африки. Саме тут базуються одні з найбільш тактично досконалих і стратегічно зрілих команд світу. У 2025 році дві команди з регіону EMEA здобули перемоги як у півсезонному фіналі, так і у гранд-фіналі серії Ignite, продемонструвавши неперевершену міць регіону. Передсезонний турнір «Ignite» 2026 року — це і випробування для визнаних грандів, і чудова нагода для нових претендентів похитнути ієрархію. Дванадцять команд змагатимуться, застосовуючи надзвичайно витончену тактику та бездоганну командну роботу, втілюючи найвищий рівень кіберспорту в Marvel Rivals.

Тут представлені одні з найбільш тактично досконалих і стратегічно зрілих команд світу. У 2025 році дві команди з регіону EMEA здобули перемоги як у півсезонному фіналі, так і у гранд-фіналі серії Ignite, продемонструвавши неперевершену міць регіону. Передсезонна серія «Ignite» 2026 року — це і випробування для визнаних грандів, і чудова нагода для нових претендентів похитнути ієрархію. Дванадцять команд змагатимуться, застосовуючи надзвичайно витончену тактику та бездоганну командну роботу, демонструючи найвищий рівень кіберспорту в Marvel Rivals.
133_MatchActivity_20001_ST.EsportsEventDescription_2026STAGE1_EMEA: Серія EMEA об’єднує традиційні гранди та висхідних зірок з Європи, Близького Сходу та Африки, що робить її одним із найбільш тактично витончених та макроорієнтованих регіонів у світі. Пил передсезонних змагань осіла, і ієрархія провідних команд почала набувати чітких обрисів, але саме 1-й етап стане справжнім переломним моментом, який визначить порядок сил у регіоні. Як чинний дворазовий чемпіон регіону 2025 року, кожна команда серії EMEA прагне довести свою силу; чи то закріплення династії, чи то повне повалення існуючого порядку — все це відбувається саме зараз. 12 команд вступлять у точні тактичні інтелектуальні баталії та запеклі бої, щоб заробити очки ліги та забезпечити собі «золоті квитки» до фіналу середини сезону.

133_MatchActivity_20001_ST.EsportsEventDescription_2026STAGE1_AMER: Серія «Америка» — це надзвичайно впливовий, ключовий регіон у глобальному конкурентному середовищі Marvel Rivals, який об’єднує найталановитіші команди найвищого рівня та зіркових гравців регіону. Пройшовши випробування та процес формування команд у передсезонному етапі, кожна команда відкрила свої карти та нагострила зброю. На 1-му етапі вже немає місця для вагань. 1-й етап серії IGNITE стане вирішальним полем битви, де гранди Америки офіційно боротимуться за очки, щоб завоювати місця на глобальному офлайн-турнірі. 12 команд розпочнуть тотальний штурм регіонального трону, продемонструвавши свої найзапекліші наступальні інстинкти та бездоганну координацію командних боїв.
133_MatchActivity_20001_ST.EsportsEventDescription_2026Preseason_AM: Серія «Америка» — це серйозний суперник на світовій арені Marvel Rivals, що об’єднує найталановитіші команди та зіркових гравців регіону. Швидкі, жорсткі та надзвичайно конкурентні — кожне протистояння насичене вибуховими командними боями та яскравими моментами, гідними потрапити до підбірки найкращих моментів. Передсезонна серія «Ignite» стане полігоном для перевірених команд, де вони зможуть відточити нові склади та стратегії. Дванадцять команд боротимуться за місце у стартовому складі, демонструючи справжню пристрасть та силу кіберспорту супергероїв.
133_MatchActivity_20001_ST.MarvelEsportsEventDescription_1001: Серія «Americas» — це серйозний суперник на світовій арені Marvel Rivals, що об’єднує найталановитіші команди та зіркових гравців із Північної, Південної та Латинської Америки. Швидкі, жорсткі та надзвичайно конкурентні — кожне протистояння насичене вибуховими командними боями та яскравими моментами, гідними потрапити до добірки найкращих. Передсезонна серія «Ignite» стане полігоном для перевірених команд, де вони зможуть відточити нові склади та стратегії. Дванадцять команд боротимуться за місце в стартовому складі ліги, демонструючи справжню пристрасть і силу кіберспорту супергероїв.
133_MatchActivity_20001_ST.MarvelEsportsEventPhaseRule_2026MSF_2: У Головному турнірі зійдуться команди, що посіли 1-е та 2-е місця в серіях «Америка» та «Європа, Близький Схід і Африка», команди, що посіли 1-е місце в серіях «Китай» та «Тихоокеанський регіон», а також дві команди, що пройшли з відбіркових турнірів. Команди, що посіли 1-е місце у всіх чотирьох основних регіонах, пропускають перший раунд; їхні пари з іншими чотирма командами визначатимуться жеребкуванням. Жеребкування також гарантуватиме, що команди з одного регіону не зустрінуться між собою у стартовому раунді. Після підтвердження результатів жеребкування 8 команд перейдуть до етапу подвійного вибування. У 1-му раунді (4 матчі) та 2-му раунді (2 матчі) верхньої сітки буде використовуватися формат BO3. У фіналі верхньої сітки та всіх матчах нижньої сітки буде використовуватися формат BO5.
